title: Prometheus Monitoring Pipeline
summary: Prometheus pulls metrics from exporters, stores them in its TSDB, evaluates rules, routes alerts via Alertmanager and serves Grafana and Thanos.

nodes.label: Exporters / Targets
nodes.detail: Applications and exporters expose metrics over HTTP in text format, such as node_exporter for host data.

nodes.label: ServiceMonitor
nodes.detail: With the Prometheus Operator, a ServiceMonitor selects Services by label and tells Prometheus how to scrape them.

nodes.label: Prometheus Server
nodes.detail: Pulls metrics on an interval, attaches labels and answers PromQL queries.

nodes.label: TSDB
nodes.detail: Writes samples to a write-ahead log, then compacts them to blocks on local disk with a configured retention.

nodes.label: Rules
nodes.detail: Recording rules precompute expensive queries. Alerting rules fire when an expression holds for a set duration.

nodes.label: Alertmanager
nodes.detail: Groups, deduplicates, silences and routes alerts to receivers such as email, chat or paging.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.detail: Queries Prometheus with PromQL to render dashboards and panels.

nodes.label: Thanos Sidecar
nodes.detail: Uploads TSDB blocks to object storage and enables global, long-retention queries across Prometheus instances.

steps.title: Targets are discovered
steps.text: A ServiceMonitor tells Prometheus which Services and ports to scrape.

steps.title: Prometheus pulls metrics
steps.text: On each interval the server scrapes /metrics from every target and records the samples.

steps.title: Samples land in the TSDB
steps.text: Data goes to the WAL and compacted local blocks, retained for a configured period.

steps.title: Rules evaluate
steps.text: Alerting rules run against the TSDB; conditions held long enough become firing alerts.

steps.title: Dashboards and archive
steps.text: Grafana queries via PromQL while Thanos ships blocks to object storage for long retention.
